- name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:
    name: Create macOS GitHub Release
    needs: [version, build-macos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 15

# so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the installer generation pipeline — every
          # sh artifact under site/ and the generator that renders them.
          # Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke (pull_request
          # + validation dispatch); the classifier failure arm above runs
          # it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^site/|^scripts/gen_installers\.dart$)'; then
            echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1659: the office add-in acceptance suite — the exact path
          # list the retired standalone office-addin.yml push/PR triggers
          # carried. Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke
          # (pull_request + validation dispatch); the classifier failure
          # arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^office_addin/|^flutter_app/|^packages/|^lib/|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/build_office_addin\.sh$|^\.github/workflows/office-addin\.yml$)'; then
            echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1684 AC3: the extension size gate — extension sources and
          # vendor supply-chain lock, the build/packaging scripts, the
          # size baseline itself (a reseed PR must re-prove the floor)
          # and everything that compiles INTO the zip (the panel app is
          # the flutter_app web build; sw/agent.js compiles lib/ + the
          # root package set). Gated on the SAME two events as
          # exzone/locksmoke (pull_request + validation dispatch); the
          # classifier failure arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^pubspec\.yaml$|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/(build_browser_ext|fetch_vendor_assets|stage_extension_panel|ext_package_guard|prune_flutter_assets)\.|^scripts/size_budget/fa-extension\.tsv$|^\.github/workflows/(ci|build-macos|pages)\.yml$)'; then
            echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables.
          # EXACT patch pin (#1431): a wildcard pin re-resolves a new
          # engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop, the canvaskit/skwasm
          # artifacts move under a new rev-hash dir and every size gate on
          # the artifact false-reds. Bump this pin consciously in the same
          # PR that reseeds any floor a real size delta moved.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

- name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.

# so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |

          # carried. Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke

          # arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1693
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1693
- **Title**: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1684` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 12
- **Additions**: +530
- **Deletions**: -122
- **Created**: 2026-10-18T13:11:23Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T13:06:43Z

## PR Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

- name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:
    name: Create macOS GitHub Release
    needs: [version, build-macos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 15

blocks.text:
# so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking

name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables.
          # EXACT patch pin (#1431): a wildcard pin re-resolves a new
          # engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop, the canvaskit/skwasm
          # artifacts move under a new rev-hash dir and every size gate on
          # the artifact false-reds. Bump this pin consciously in the same
          # PR that reseeds any floor a real size delta moved.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

# pr-1693: gh-1684 [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

Closes #1684
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

- name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:
    name: Create macOS GitHub Release
    needs: [version, build-macos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 15

blocks.text:
# so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables.
          # EXACT patch pin (#1431): a wildcard pin re-resolves a new
          # engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop, the canvaskit/skwasm
          # artifacts move under a new rev-hash dir and every size gate on
          # the artifact false-reds. Bump this pin consciously in the same
          # PR that reseeds any floor a real size delta moved.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

  extension-size-gate:
    name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # dart2js agent (~1m) + flutter web release build (~2m) + vendor
    # fetch (~1m) — historically ~10m end to end.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4: the SAME exact patch pin every other
          # fa-extension.zip leg uses (#1431 — a wildcard pin
          # re-resolves a new engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop;
          # the rev normalization absorbs the path churn, the pin keeps
          # the builds comparable across legs).
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
      # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
      # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

- name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:
    name: Create macOS GitHub Release
    needs: [version, build-macos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 15

blocks.text:
# so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the installer generation pipeline — every
          # sh artifact under site/ and the generator that renders them.
          # Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke (pull_request
          # + validation dispatch); the classifier failure arm above runs
          # it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^site/|^scripts/gen_installers\.dart$)'; then
            echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1659: the office add-in acceptance suite — the exact path
          # list the retired standalone office-addin.yml push/PR triggers
          # carried. Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke
          # (pull_request + validation dispatch); the classifier failure
          # arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^office_addin/|^flutter_app/|^packages/|^lib/|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/build_office_addin\.sh$|^\.github/workflows/office-addin\.yml$)'; then
            echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1684 AC3: the extension size gate — extension sources and
          # vendor supply-chain lock, the build/packaging scripts, the
          # size baseline itself (a reseed PR must re-prove the floor)
          # and everything that compiles INTO the zip (the panel app is
          # the flutter_app web build; sw/agent.js compiles lib/ + the
          # root package set). Gated on the SAME two events as
          # exzone/locksmoke (pull_request + validation dispatch); the
          # classifier failure arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^pubspec\.yaml$|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/(build_browser_ext|fetch_vendor_assets|stage_extension_panel|ext_package_guard|prune_flutter_assets)\.|^scripts/size_budget/fa-extension\.tsv$|^\.github/workflows/(ci|build-macos|pages)\.yml$)'; then
            echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            # Dispatch done — the stages classifier below reads a
            # pull_request event's base/head only; on dispatches the group
            # outputs stay with the non-PR filter step (full gate).
            exit 0
          fi
          stages=$(scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run |
            sed -n 's/^Fast gate scope: .*stages://p')
          echo "gate stages:[$stages]"
          # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.
          [ -z "$(echo $stages)" ] && stages="size analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"
          case " $stages " in *"flutter"*) echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" ;; esac

name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables.
          # EXACT patch pin (#1431): a wildcard pin re-resolves a new
          # engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop, the canvaskit/skwasm
          # artifacts move under a new rev-hash dir and every size gate on
          # the artifact false-reds. Bump this pin consciously in the same
          # PR that reseeds any floor a real size delta moved.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

  extension-size-gate:
    name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&

- name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:
    name: Create macOS GitHub Release
    needs: [version, build-macos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 15

# so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the installer generation pipeline — every
          # sh artifact under site/ and the generator that renders them.
          # Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke (pull_request
          # + validation dispatch); the classifier failure arm above runs
          # it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^site/|^scripts/gen_installers\.dart$)'; then
            echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1659: the office add-in acceptance suite — the exact path
          # list the retired standalone office-addin.yml push/PR triggers
          # carried. Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke
          # (pull_request + validation dispatch); the classifier failure
          # arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^office_addin/|^flutter_app/|^packages/|^lib/|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/build_office_addin\.sh$|^\.github/workflows/office-addin\.yml$)'; then
            echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1684 AC3: the extension size gate — extension sources and
          # vendor supply-chain lock, the build/packaging scripts, the
          # size baseline itself (a reseed PR must re-prove the floor)
          # and everything that compiles INTO the zip (the panel app is
          # the flutter_app web build; sw/agent.js compiles lib/ + the
          # root package set). Gated on the SAME two events as
          # exzone/locksmoke (pull_request + validation dispatch); the
          # classifier failure arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^pubspec\.yaml$|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/(build_browser_ext|fetch_vendor_assets|stage_extension_panel|ext_package_guard|prune_flutter_assets)\.|^scripts/size_budget/fa-extension\.tsv$|^\.github/workflows/(ci|build-macos|pages)\.yml$)'; then
            echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables.
          # EXACT patch pin (#1431): a wildcard pin re-resolves a new
          # engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop, the canvaskit/skwasm
          # artifacts move under a new rev-hash dir and every size gate on
          # the artifact false-reds. Bump this pin consciously in the same
          # PR that reseeds any floor a real size delta moved.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

  extension-size-gate:
    name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # dart2js agent (~1m) + flutter web release build (~2m) + vendor
    # fetch (~1m) — historically ~10m end to end.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4: the SAME exact patch pin every other
          # fa-extension.zip leg uses (#1431 — a wildcard pin
          # re-resolves a new engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop;
          # the rev normalization absorbs the path churn, the pin keeps
          # the builds comparable across legs).
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
      # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
      # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

blocks.text:
- name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:
    name: Create macOS GitHub Release
    needs: [version, build-macos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 15

Root `vendor/` contains git- deps (dart_tui, flutter_inappwebview_*, wasm_run, xterm) — these are pub/git path deps that get compiled INTO the sw agent (dart2js of lib/ + deps) and possibly the flutter panel app. A change under `vendor/wasm_run/` etc. changes compiled output → moves the zip manifest → but does NOT trigger the extsize classifier (no `^vendor/` in the regex)!

Wait — would a vendor bump also change pubspec.lock? A vendored path dep bump (pubspec.yaml override pointing at vendor/... path) — the lock file pins path deps? pubspec.lock does record path-deps with path? Actually path deps in pubspec.lock record "path": "..." and sha? No — path dependencies in pubspec.lock have no content hash; a lockfile wouldn't change when the vendored source changes. And dependency_overides with path: vendor/wasm_run — the lock entry describes the source path but not content. So a PR that modifies `vendor/wasm_run/**` code (without touching pubspec.yaml/lock) would compile different JS into the zip → size moves → gate skipped → regression reaches the release leg → the release extension gate goes red AFTER merge — the exact bug class gh-1684 is fixing ("two-legs-green-one-leg-red" inverted: the PR leg never ran).

Hmm wait, but is that realistic? Vendor dirs are git-checkouts of pinned deps — a PR touching them is rare but possible (a vendor pin bump = changing files under vendor/ + maybe vendor.lock.json? No, root vendor/ is NOT the same as browser_ext/vendor.lock.json vendored engines). Let me check how root vendor/ is wired: pubspec.yaml dependency_overides?

Also the daily-publish.yml comment and pages.yml triggers: pages.yml still triggers on `vendor/**` (kept in the diff — the on.push.paths kept `vendor/**`). So pages considers vendor/** able to move the website artifact (the web app build). The extension zip includes the panel app = flutter_app web build; flutter_app deps include the vendored wasm_run_flutter etc. So YES — root vendor/** can move the zip size.

The extsize classifier misses `^vendor/`. Also misses `^flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` etc.? flutter_app/** covers those. What about `analysis_options.yaml` (no size impact)? Fine.

Also `bench/`, `test/` — no impact on zip. `packages/**` covered. Root `bin/` — does the sw agent include bin/? The comment says "sw/agent.js compiles lib/ + the root package set" — bin/ not compiled. Probably fine.

So finding #1 (IMPORTANT): the extsize path classifier omits `^vendor/` — a PR touching vendored dependency sources (e.g., wasm_run_flutter engine code compiled into the sw agent / panel app) can shift the zip manifest without arming the PR gate — recreating the merge-then-red-release failure mode for that class of diff. Add `^vendor/` to the regex.
